headline: Wall Street Ends Higher as Federal Reserve Holds Key Interest Rate Steady
summary: US stock markets ended higher after the Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate steady, with investors turning their focus to corporate earnings.
why: Federal Reserve interest rate decisions dictate the cost of capital across the global economy, directly influencing equity valuations and borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Financials
impacts.why: The Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady removed immediate monetary tightening fears, supporting broader equity index gains.

why_moved: The Federal Reserve maintaining its key interest rate unchanged reassured investors seeking monetary policy stability, lifting equity indices.
